definition{
  name: ordering_is_Less,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => true
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => false
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => false)
}

definition{
  name: ordering_is_Equal,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => false
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => true
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => false)
}

definition{
  name: ordering_is_Greater,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => false
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => false
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => true)
}

definition{
  name: reverse_Ordering,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
}

definition{
  name: compare_Priority,
  parameters: [left : Priority, right : Priority],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match left
    | Priority.Low => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Priority.Normal => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Priority.Urgent => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)))
}

theorem{
  name: compare_Priority_reflexive,
  parameters: [a : Priority],
  statement: ((compare_Priority a a) = (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)),
  proof: cases{
    branches: [
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
    ],
    scrutinee: a
  }
}

theorem{
  name: compare_Priority_antisymmetric,
  parameters: [a : Priority, b : Priority],
  statement: ((compare_Priority a b) = (reverse_Ordering (compare_Priority b a))),
  proof: cases{
    branches: [
      {
        proof: cases{
          branches: [
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
          ],
          scrutinee: b
        },
        binders: [],
        constructor: Low
      },
      {
        proof: cases{
          branches: [
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
          ],
          scrutinee: b
        },
        binders: [],
        constructor: Normal
      },
      {
        proof: cases{
          branches: [
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
          ],
          scrutinee: b
        },
        binders: [],
        constructor: Urgent
      }
    ],
    scrutinee: a
  }
}

definition{
  name: compare_String,
  parameters: [left : String, right : String],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (if (prim less_than left right : Bool) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Less) else (if (prim equal left right : Bool) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal) else (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: compare_Request,
  parameters: [left : Request, right : Request],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match (compare_Priority (project left priority) (project right priority))
    | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => (match (compare_String (project left room) (project right room))
      | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: compare_Zone,
  parameters: [left : Zone, right : Zone],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match left
    | Zone.Room x0 => (match right
      | Zone.Room y0 => (match (compare_String x0 y0)
        | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
        | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
        | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
      | Zone.Group y0 => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Zone.Group x0 => (match right
      | Zone.Room y0 => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Zone.Group y0 => (match (compare_ListZone x0 y0)
        | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
        | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
        | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  mutual: CompareOfZone,
  recursive_argument: left
}

definition{
  name: compare_ListZone,
  parameters: [left : (List Zone), right : (List Zone)],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match left
    | List.nil => (match right
      | List.nil => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | List.cons y0 y1 => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | List.cons x0 x1 => (match right
      | List.nil => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | List.cons y0 y1 => (match (compare_Zone x0 y0)
        | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
        | CmpOrdering.Equal => (match (compare_ListZone x1 y1)
          | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
          | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
          | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
        | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  mutual: CompareOfZone,
  recursive_argument: left
}

definition{
  name: compare_Nat,
  parameters: [left : Nat, right : Nat],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (if (left <? right) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Less) else (if (left =? right) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal) else (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)))
}

definition{
  name: compare_TuplePriorityNat,
  parameters: [left : TuplePriorityNat, right : TuplePriorityNat],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match (compare_Priority (project left item0) (project right item0))
    | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => (match (compare_Nat (project left item1) (project right item1))
      | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
}

definition{
  name: width,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (if ((project band low) <=? (project band high)) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim subtract (project band high) (project band low) : Nat)) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
}

definition{
  name: checkedMidpoint,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (match (if (((project band low) + (project band high)) <? 4294967296) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] ((project band low) + (project band high))) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Nat])
    | Option.some sum => (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim quotient sum 2 0 : Nat)))
}

definition{
  name: tick,
  parameters: [counter : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (prim remainder (counter + 1) 256 0 : Nat)
}

definition{
  name: shortfall,
  parameters: [band : Band, current : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (prim subtract (project band low) current : Nat)
}

definition{
  name: freezing,
  parameters: [outdoor : Int64],
  result: Bool,
  body: (not (prim less_than (0 : Int64) outdoor : Bool)),
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
  name: delta,
  parameters: [before : Int64, after : Int64],
  result: (Option Int64),
  body: (prim checked_subtract after before : (Option Int64))
}

definition{
  name: checkedValue,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: TupleBandBool,
  body: (record TupleBandBool {item0 := band, item1 := ((project band low) <=? (project band high))})
}

definition{
  name: isCelsius,
  parameters: [unit : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((prim equal unit "C" : Bool) || (prim equal unit "celsius" : Bool))
}

definition{
  name: above,
  parameters: [readings : (List Nat), target : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match readings
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons firstValue rest => (if (target <? firstValue) then (if (((above rest target) + 1) <? 4294967296) then ((above rest target) + 1) else 4294967295) else (above rest target))),
  recursive_argument: readings
}

definition{
  name: firstReading,
  parameters: [readings : (List Nat)],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (prim index readings 0 : (Option Nat))
}

definition{
  name: targetOr,
  parameters: [setting : (Option Nat), default : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match setting | Option.none => default | Option.some value1 => value1)
}

definition{
  name: heatFor,
  parameters: [band : (Result Band ConfigError), current : Nat],
  result: (Result Bool ConfigError),
  body: (match band
    | Result.ok band2 => (ctor Result.ok [Bool, ConfigError] (current <? (project band2 low)))
    | Result.error error1 => (ctor Result.error [Bool, ConfigError] error1))
}

definition{
  name: fanLabel,
  parameters: [speed : Nat],
  result: String,
  body: (if (speed =? 0) then "off" else (if ((speed =? 1) || (speed =? 2)) then "low" else "high"))
}

definition{
  name: labelled,
  parameters: [value : String, unit : String],
  result: String,
  body: (prim join (cons value (cons " " (cons unit (nil String)))) "" : String),
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
  name: lowOf,
  parameters: [band : (Result Band ConfigError)],
  result: (Result Nat ConfigError),
  body: (match band
    | Result.ok band2 => (ctor Result.ok [Nat, ConfigError] (project band2 low))
    | Result.error error1 => (ctor Result.error [Nat, ConfigError] error1))
}

definition{
  name: notANumber,
  parameters: [error : ConfigError],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match error | ConfigError.Unreadable => false | ConfigError.NotANumber => true)
}

definition{
  name: withHigh,
  parameters: [band : Band, high : Nat],
  result: Band,
  body: (record Band {low := (project band low), high := high})
}

definition{
  name: withLow,
  parameters: [band : Band, low : Nat],
  result: Band,
  body: (let out : Band := band; (let out1 : Band := (record Band {low := low, high := (project out high)}); out1))
}

definition{
  name: joined,
  parameters: [firstValue : (List Nat), secondValue : (List Nat)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (let out : (List Nat) := firstValue; (let out1 : (List Nat) := (prim append out secondValue : (List Nat)); out1))
}

definition{name: labelOf, parameters: [view : Labelled], result: String, body: (project view label)}

definition{
  name: parseTarget,
  parameters: [text : String],
  result: (Result Nat ConfigError),
  body: (match (Prelude::textParseNat (Prelude::textTrim text) 4294967295)
    | Result.ok value3 => (ctor Result.ok [Nat, ConfigError] value3)
    | Result.error item2 => (ctor Result.error [Nat, ConfigError] (ctor ConfigError.NotANumber))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: shouldHeat,
  parameters: [current : Nat, target : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (current <? target)
}

definition{
  name: withinBand,
  parameters: [current : Nat, low : Nat, high : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((low <=? current) && (current <=? high))
}

definition{
  name: nextMode,
  parameters: [mode : Mode, coldArg : Bool, hot : Bool],
  result: Mode,
  body: (match mode
    | Mode.Idle => (if coldArg then (ctor Mode.Heating) else (if hot then (ctor Mode.Cooling) else (ctor Mode.Idle)))
    | Mode.Heating => (if coldArg then (ctor Mode.Heating) else (ctor Mode.Idle))
    | Mode.Cooling => (if hot then (ctor Mode.Cooling) else (ctor Mode.Idle)))
}

definition{
  name: halt,
  parameters: [mode : Mode],
  result: Mode,
  body: (match mode
    | Mode.Idle => (ctor Mode.Idle)
    | Mode.Heating => (ctor Mode.Idle)
    | Mode.Cooling => (ctor Mode.Idle))
}

definition{
  name: midpoint,
  parameters: [low : Nat, high : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (prim quotient (low + high) 2 0 : Nat)
}

definition{
  name: roomIsCold,
  parameters: [selfValue : Room, floor : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((project selfValue reading) <? floor)
}

definition{
  name: roomReread,
  parameters: [selfValue : Room, reading : Nat],
  result: Room,
  body: (record Room {name := (project selfValue name), reading := reading})
}

definition{
  name: roomLabel,

        | List.nil => (let label : String := (field_Phase_label value); (ctor Option.some [String] label))
        | List.cons value2 rest3 => (ctor Option.none [String]))
      | Step.Either value4 rest5 => (ctor Option.none [String])
      | Step.Sequence value6 => (ctor Option.none [String])))
}

definition{
  name: modeFor,
  parameters: [coldArg : Bool, hot : Bool],
  result: Mode,
  body: (if coldArg then (if hot then (ctor Mode.Idle) else (ctor Mode.Heating)) else (if hot then (ctor Mode.Cooling) else (ctor Mode.Idle)))
}

definition{
  name: comfortablePart1,
  parameters: [low : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (let t : Nat := low; ((18 <=? t) && (t <=? 24)))
}

definition{
  name: comfortablePart2,
  parameters: [high : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (let t : Nat := high; ((18 <=? t) && (t <=? 24)))
}

definition{
  name: comfortable,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: Bool,
  body: (let low : Nat := (project band low); (let high : Nat := (project band high); ((comfortablePart1 low) && (comfortablePart2 high))))
}

definition{
  name: either,
  parameters: [occupied : Step, otherwise : Step],
  result: Step,
  body: (ctor Step.Either occupied otherwise)
}

definition{
  name: atLeastLoop1,
  parameters: [items3 : (List Nat), state1 : (List Nat), floor : Nat],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match items3
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons r rest4 => (match (if (floor <=? r) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim subtract r floor : Nat)) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
      | Option.none => (atLeastLoop1 rest4 state1 floor)
      | Option.some kept => (let out2 : (List Nat) := (prim append state1 (cons kept (nil Nat)) : (List Nat)); (atLeastLoop1 rest4 out2 floor)))),
  recursive_argument: items3
}

definition{
  name: atLeast,
  parameters: [readings : (List Nat), floor : Nat],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (let out : (List Nat) := (nil Nat); (let state5 : (List Nat) := (atLeastLoop1 readings out floor); state5))
}

definition{name: heldUnit, parameters: [], result: String, body: "C"}

definition{
  name: numberedPart2,
  parameters: [i : Nat],
  result: String,
  body: (match (prim index (positions) (if (i <=? 2) then i else 2) : (Option String))
    | Option.none => ""
    | Option.some item7 => item7)
}

definition{
  name: numberedLoop3,
  parameters: [items9 : (List TupleNatRoom), state5 : (List String)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match items9
    | List.nil => state5
    | List.cons pair6 rest10 => (let i : Nat := (project pair6 item0); (let room : Room := (project pair6 item1); (let out8 : (List String) := (prim append state5 (cons (prim join (cons (numberedPart2 i) (cons ":" (cons (project room name) (nil String)))) "" : String) (nil String)) : (List String)); (numberedLoop3 rest10 out8))))),
  axioms: [propext],
  recursive_argument: items9
}

definition{
  name: numbered,
  parameters: [rooms : (List Room)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (let out : (List String) := (nil String); (let state11 : (List String) := (numberedLoop3 (numberedEnumerate1 rooms 0) out); state11)),
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
  name: describe,
  parameters: [phase : Phase],
  result: String,
  body: (let target : Nat := (describePart1 phase); (let sequence : Bool := (isSequence (field_Phase_step phase)); (prim join (cons (field_Phase_label phase) (cons ": " (cons (Prelude::natDecimal target) (cons (heldUnit) (cons " (sequence: " (cons (if sequence then "true" else "false") (cons ")" (nil String)))))))) "" : String))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
